title: Arc length formula
text: The arc length is the integral of $$\sqrt{\left(\frac{dx}{dt}\right)^2+\left(\frac{dy}{dt}\right)^2}$$ over the interval.

title: Evaluate
text: $$\frac{dx}{dt}=e^t \left(cos\left(t\right)-sin\left(t\right)\right)$$ and $$\frac{dy}{dt}=e^t \left(sin\left(t\right)+cos\left(t\right)\right)$$. Their squares add to $$2e^{2t}$$, so the integrand is $$\sqrt{2} e^t$$. The arc length is $$\sqrt{2} \left(e^{\frac{\pi}{2}}-1\right)$$, which is about $$5.389$$.
